title: Stanislav Petrov — the Soviet officer who personally prevented WW3
voiceover: In 1983, one Soviet officer single-handedly prevented World War 3. His name was Stanislav Petrov. He was on duty at a Russian early warning bunker when the alarms went off. The system reported five American nuclear missiles inbound. Protocol said to report it immediately. Soviet doctrine said to launch everything in retaliation. Petrov had minutes. He called it a false alarm. He was right. A satellite glitch had mistaken sunlight on clouds for missiles. If he had followed protocol, hundreds of millions of people would have died that day. He told no one for over a decade. He died in 2017, mostly unknown. Follow Mindbloom for one fact a day.
emphasis: hundreds of millions would have died
